tip.title: Plans with ir a
tip.body: Use ir a and a verb for plans. Voy a comer means I am going to eat. Vamos a salir means we are going to go out.

tip.title: Looking ahead
tip.body: Que viene means next: la semana que viene. Dentro de means in, for time ahead: dentro de dos días. Pasado mañana is the day after tomorrow.

tip.title: Yes and no, politely
tip.body: After querer and poder, use the infinitive: ¿Quieres venir? To say no, say sorry first and give a reason: Lo siento, no puedo.

exercises.prompt: How do you say "maybe another day"?
I would love to but I am busy

tip.title: Telling the time
tip.body: Use a las plus the hour: a las tres. For one o'clock, say a la una. Hacia means around: hacia el mediodía.

tip.title: Weather plans
tip.body: For weather, use va a hacer plus calor, frío or sol. Rain and snow have their own verbs: va a llover, va a nevar.
